reviewed_by: Claude: Butler mode stop on harness threads
reason: Butler mode's Stop sent a harness turn ID to the chat-turn cancel route (404) once a harness-backed thread ran a tool, because harness tool frames carry only harness_turn_id. The thread activity reducer now keeps the chat turn from queued/admitted/started frames. Selected the reducer unit tests and the Butler mode page tests, including a new send-then-stop journey.
exclusions: No Core, parser or other-surface change: SessionsPage, the Butler panel and Ask Nebula read their turn IDs elsewhere and are untouched. No Python, native or Playwright coverage applies to this UI reducer change.
